plan: Identify maximal chains of the Boolean lattice with permutations of [n], giving n! chains.
For A of size k, count k!(n-k)! maximal chains containing A.
Use the antichain property to show a maximal chain contains at most one member of the family and double-count incidences, yielding the LYM inequality.
Prove the middle binomial coefficient is maximal by adjacent ratios and conclude the stated bound.
Check the full middle layer is an antichain and has the required cardinality.
proof_policy: Self-contained proof; no external results or predecessor facts.
